title: Health Centre and Medical Care
aliases: is there a doctor on campus
what do I do if I get sick
content: VIT-AP has an on-campus Health Centre providing 24/7 outpatient services with a 10-bed facility, staffed by resident doctors (Dr. Surya Avinash Ramanapudi, Dr. Lakshmi Lavanya CH) and nursing staff. The university has an ambulance tie-up with Manipal Hospitals, Vijayawada, for emergencies. Campus emergency ambulance contact: 7997965624.
